_about: Ad blocking lists for the Android app, read at launch and every 6 hours. A file with any invalid entry is ignored whole. adHosts: hosts to answer with nothing, check what a host serves before adding it, because video comes from odd-looking domains too. scriptLibraries: where the stream embeds may load scripts from besides their own domain, as plain https addresses; if a server stops playing because of a blocked script, add its source here.
